scientific_integrity: The exact cycle Green kernel and median duality are known ingredients and are not claimed as new. Universal statements rest on an analytical proof; finite verifier results are corroborative. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Real-valued sequences, unit-edge finite cycles n>=3, unnormalized counting-measure Laplacian. Does not cover weighted, complex, or higher-dimensional cases. Earlier implicit Favard-type formulations are a residual priority risk.
title: Sharp cyclic Poisson Lipschitz constants with a four-residue quantization law
